notes: Seed https://www.collincountytx.gov/elections works. No Clarity site (clarity script: 'no Clarity election list (404)'). The Election Results page says the county publishes unofficial results from its tabulation system on that page: early voting at 7 p.m., updates from 8:30 p.m. at half-hour intervals; it does not say whether election-night results are by precinct. Only official files remain for all three elections, so election night cannot be judged from the live site. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin). Targeted pass 2026-10-02 (targeted-Collin): no election changed; all three stay UNDETERMINED. Tried: (1) main Wayback harvest phase1/wayback_snapshots/Collin: 23 saved 2024 election-night captures, none of a results page (the 20:26 CST capture of /Elections/live is the Election Livestreams video page; the rest are absentee, default and info pages with no results content); 0 captures for the 2026 primary; 1 runoff capture (voter-registration page, 23:27 CDT) with no results content. (2) phase1/targeted/archives/Collin and phase1/targeted/wayback/Collin: not on the wayback-data branch as of the last fetch (batch 3), so the extended check 3 is still pending. (3) Wayback CDX query through the fetch module: refused (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). (4) Current results page source: plain Sitefinity PDF/CSV links, no JSON/XML data feed; page text says 'The time of the latest returns will appear in the bottom left corner of the result page'. (5) Site-restricted web searches located election-night file names that are now 404: 'March 3, 2026 Primary Election Early Voting Summary Report.pdf' (/Elections/ElectionResults/), 'may-26-2026---primary-runoff-election---early-voting-summary-report.pdf' and 'may-26-2026---primary-runoff-election---election-night-summary-report---unofficial-final.pdf' (/docs/default-source/elections/election-results/); search text is not evidence and no unofficial election-night precinct report name was found for any of the three elections (lead: election-night postings appear to be summary reports). (6) County ArcGIS Election_Department map service: boundary layers only, no results. (7) Check 4: Community Impact Nov 5 2024 roundup (posted 7:29 p.m. Nov 5, updated 6:41 a.m. Nov 6) shows county totals only; Murphy Monitor (Star Local Media) Nov 6 2024 shows county totals only; FOX 4 May 26 2026 live page embeds media.foxtv.com/kdfw/elections/Collin.html with race totals and precincts-reporting only; searches for Dallas Morning News or KERA precinct maps found none. No per-precinct candidate numbers with an election-night time were found.
tag_rationale: No election could be determined from checks 1 and 2, so the tag is UNKNOWN.

2024_general.fact: The Results Archive keeps only official/post-canvass 2024 general files ('november-5-2024---statement-of-votes-cast---official-final.pdf', 'combined-accumulated-totals-official-final') plus an early-ballots accumulated totals file; the election-night results page content is gone. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: The Results Archive keeps only 'Precinct Results Report - Official Totals', 'Election Summary Report - Official Totals', precinct export (official) and reconciliation forms for the March 3, 2026 primary; no election-night files remain. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: The Results Archive keeps only 'Precinct Results Report - Official Totals', 'Summary Results Report - Official Totals', an official export CSV and reconciliation forms for the May 26, 2026 runoff; no election-night files remain. Check 3 pending.
